extension.summary: Daylight - a skin that knows what time it is.
extension.description: Soft, rounded and calm. Its colours follow the day (pale morning, bright afternoon, amber evening, deep blue night) and Home suggests what fits right now: films that end before your bedtime, the next episode, something long when it rains. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.9 - Sets row in the Library panel; fix for controls disappearing with Reduce motion on. Code clean-up for the Kodi repository checks.
